# chameleon_workspace (Data Source)

Fetch a Chameleon workspace and its catalog bindings by slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a workspace and its catalog bindings by slug.
data "chameleon_workspace" "team_a" {
  slug = "team-a"
}

output "team_a_catalog" {
  value = data.chameleon_workspace.team_a.primary_catalog
}

output "team_a_catalogs" {
  value = data.chameleon_workspace.team_a.catalogs
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Workspace slug to look up.

### Read-Only

- `admin_group` (String) Admin Keycloak group.
- `catalogs` (Attributes List) Catalog bindings on the workspace (OWNER and ATTACHED). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--catalogs))
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Provisioning admin username.
- `default_namespace` (String) Default namespace.
- `description` (String) Workspace description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable workspace name.
- `id` (String) Workspace slug (matches `slug`).
- `member_group` (String) Member Keycloak group.
- `primary_catalog` (String) Catalog owned by the workspace.
- `staging_bucket` (String) Staging S3 bucket.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp.
- `warehouse_bucket` (String) Warehouse S3 bucket.
- `workspace_id` (String) Server-assigned workspace UUID.

<a id="nestedatt--catalogs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `catalogs`

Read-Only:

- `access` (String) OWNER or ATTACHED.
- `catalog_name` (String)
- `source_workspace_id` (String) Owning workspace UUID for ATTACHED bindings.
